description: Prospective exploratory retrieval study over three project documents and explicitly synthetic fixtures; relevance labels are not yet independently reviewed.

implementer.purpose: Implement the requested change with source evidence.

reviewer.purpose: Review implementation and source evidence for missing or unsupported claims.

tasks.query: Implement a searchable source-linked fallback for a document with no headings.
Review how broad document sections gain finer topic navigation without losing the original source.
Implement a finding that cites its supporting source section and revision.
Review whether an agent claim with no evidence is presented as unsupported.
Handle a decision-model timeout without suppressing baseline source evidence.
Review what a bounded context packet includes and what is outside its budget.
Use role-specific usefulness estimates without filtering a relevant source.
Review whether a low usefulness score can hide task-relevant evidence.
Handle a source document that changes after an agent finding was created.
Review whether a finding linked to the old retry limit has stale evidence.
Identify the documented retry limit when a synthetic agent finding states a conflicting limit.
Distinguish the synthetic conflicting finding from its source and an unsupported claim.
Choose a fallback when local decision-model inference is unavailable.
Assess whether the reported decision-model scores establish calibrated task accuracy.
Record enough information to reproduce a matched retrieval comparison and account for provider calls.
Review what independent labels and agent-outcome evidence are required before claiming a swarm benefit.

comparison.primary_metric: per-task exact-ID recall at the fixed packet budget
comparison.limits: The packet budget excludes each model's prompt framing and input; switch performs its own extra decision calls. Exact-ID matching does not prove a truncated passage contains the required evidence. Shared project documents and earlier exploratory exposure prevent treating the split as independent by construction.
